message.content:
{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study performs a systematic review and meta-analysis of quantitative data from previous studies of in vivo animal or human models after interventions which mimic sepsis conditions, specifically analyzing IRAK3 expression and its correlation to inflammatory cytokine expression. This directly measures agreement between animal model findings and human disease outcomes.",
  "arm": "disease-biology",
  "arm_evidence": "The purpose of this review is to analyse IRAK3 expression, and its effects and correlation to inflammatory cytokine expression (TNF-α and IL-6), using meta-analyses of quantitative data from previous studies of in vivo animal or human models after one- or two-challenge interventions which mimic sepsis conditions.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "sepsis-inflammation",
    "infectious-disease"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Sepsis is one of the major causes of mortality in intensive care units... Sepsis is defined as severe organ dysfunction or failure caused by dysregulated host inflammatory responses to microbial infections...",
  "model_type": "infection-challenge",
  "model_evidence": "The included studies were restricted to human and animal in vivo studies... Animals were in vivo challenged with bacteria... or inflammation-inducing chemicals (e.g., TLR4 agonist–LPS, TLR2 agonists–Pam3CSK4...)",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat",
    "pig",
    "cattle",
    "sheep",
    "non-human-primate"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "Of the 49 included in vivo studies, 12 studies reported data from experiments performed using in vivo human model... 34 studies used rodents (mice or rats), and the remaining three used sheep, cows or pigs.",
  "endpoint_class": "secondary-biomarker",
  "endpoint_evidence": "Outcomes that are measures of IRAK3 and inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6) mRNA and protein expression level were included."
}
